Refus.PasCadavre: This creature is not a corpse.
Refus.PasAToi: You do not own this character.
Refus.MJSeul: Only the GM can search corpses.
Refus.Loin: Too far away: step closer to search.

Notice.NoGM: No GM connected: searching needs an active GM.

Chat.Caught: {thief} tried to rob {victim} and was caught (Sleight of Hand {total} vs DC {dc}).

Reach.Name: Search reach
Reach.Hint: How close a character must be to a corpse to search it, in scene units (edge to edge).

WhoLoots.Name: Who can search corpses
WhoLoots.Hint: Players themselves, or the GM only.

Announce.Name: Announce what is taken
Announce.Hint: A chat message listing what was taken from a corpse.

AutoTreasure.Name: Roll treasure on corpses
AutoTreasure.Hint: The first time a corpse is searched, roll its individual treasure by CR (DMG 2024): coins, or gemstones (Arcana) and art objects (Relics) when the Dungeon Master's Guide module is active. Creatures without a treasure preference have none.

Pockets.Name: Humanoid pockets
Pockets.Hint: Humanoids may also carry a few mundane items (rations, candles, a torch, a trinket…) from the Player's Handbook.

TheftHostile.Name: Caught thieves make enemies
TheftHostile.Hint: When a pickpocket fails, the victim's token turns hostile. Otherwise it only becomes wary and the GM is told.

DropMode.Name: Drop items on the ground
DropMode.Hint: Drag an item from a character sheet onto the map to drop it there (a half-square pile, picked up like a container).

ThrownWeapons.Name: Thrown weapons leave the hand
ThrownWeapons.Hint: A weapon thrown with the combat engine leaves the thrower: on a hit it stays lodged in the target half the time (in its inventory, recoverable when it dies), otherwise it drops at the target's feet; on a miss it lands 1–3 squares beyond, stopped by walls.

SearchRadius.Name: Search radius
SearchRadius.Hint: Distance (scene units) that "Search the surroundings" covers, stopped by walls. A hidden object may require less.

Lock.NoWay: You have neither the key nor thieves' tools.

label.label: Name
label.hint: Shown in the search window title. Empty: the region name.

actor.label: Contents
actor.hint: The Group actor holding the contents, created automatically. Open its sheet to drop items and coins in.

table.label: Roll table
table.hint: Rolled once, the first time the container is opened. Linked items, @UUID item links in the text, or plain text (becomes a loot item).

draws.label: Draws
draws.hint: How many times the table is rolled.

hoard.label: Treasure hoard
hoard.hint: Random Treasure Hoard (DMG 2024) of that CR band: coins and magic items, rolled once at first opening.

theme.label: Treasure theme
theme.hint: Arcana: gemstones; Relics: art objects; magic items from that theme's tables (Any: 1d4 per item).

rolled.label: Already rolled
rolled.hint: Untick to roll the table and hoard again at the next opening (adds to the contents).

locked.label: Locked
locked.hint: Opened with the key, thieves' tools (Dexterity check) or by the GM.

dc.label: Lock DC
dc.hint: Thieves' tools check to pick the lock.

key.label: Key
key.hint: Name of the item that opens the lock (case ignored).

owner.label: Owner
owner.hint: Whoever owns the contents. If set, whatever is taken is flagged as stolen from them.

Tables.MenuHint: Creates in this world the generic loot tables (chest, barrel, crate, bookshelf, desk, altar, camp bag) from Player's Handbook items, in the “Loot — tables” folder. Tables already created are left as they are.
Tables.NeedPHB: The Player's Handbook module must be active.

Steal.Title: Pickpocket: {name}
Steal.Hint: One try per item. A failure is noticed.

Necro.DialogCaster: Under the control of {name} (the selected token).
Necro.DialogNoCaster: No caster selected: the undead will belong to no player.
Necro.Name: {undead} ({name})
Necro.NotRaisable: Only the corpse of a Small or Medium humanoid can be raised.
Necro.NeedMM: The Monster Manual module must be active.

Drop.NotOnScene: Your character is not on this scene.

Trade.Title: Trade: {a} ⇄ {b}
Trade.DropHint: Drag items from your sheet here.
Trade.NotYours: Only items of your own character can be offered.
Trade.Impossible: You can only trade with another player character.
Trade.WindowFailed: The trade window could not open: {reason}

Shop.Title: Shop: {name}
Shop.Hint: Click: one item onto the tray (Shift: the whole stack). Click on the tray: take it back.
Shop.GMHint: Right-click an item: displayed but not for sale → hidden → for sale.
Shop.TooFar: Too far: get closer to the merchant.
Shop.MerchantNoFunds: The merchant doesn't have enough money: take something else in exchange.
Shop.Refused: The merchant refuses this stolen item.
Shop.Fenced: Stolen item: bought at a discount.
Shop.Changed: The stock or your inventory changed: check the trade.

Merchant.Title: Merchant: {name}
Merchant.EnabledHint: Players open the shop by clicking its token, out of combat.
Merchant.OwnerHint: The shop refuses anything stolen from this name.
Merchant.BuyHint: What the player pays: item price × this factor.
Merchant.SellHint: What the merchant gives: item price × this factor (0.5: half price).
Merchant.AttitudeHint: Friendly: 10% in the player's favour. Hostile: 20% against.

StolenPolicy.own: Refuses what was stolen from them

Merchant.FenceRateHint: Share of the selling price given for a stolen item.
Merchant.TablesHint: Tables drawn at each restock (what had been drawn goes first).
Merchant.MemorizeHint: Restocking will bring the fixed stock and the till back to their present state.
Merchant.TypesHint: Factors multiplied with the merchant's (1: no effect).
Merchant.CharactersHint: Attitude towards them, and discount in % (positive: in their favour).
Merchant.ItemPiles: This actor is an Item Piles merchant.

label.label: Name
label.hint: Zone name. Empty: the target document's name, else the region's.

reach.label: Require reach
reach.hint: The character must be within reach ("Reach" setting); out of reach, they walk there first. Uncheck for a zone usable from afar.

Zone.NoScene: This zone leads to no scene.
Zone.NoDocument: This zone opens no journal or page.
Zone.NoPermission: You may not read this document.
Zone.GrantFailed: The document could not be shared with you.

MacroZone.Hint: Clicking the region runs a macro for whoever clicks, even without permission on it.

macro.label: Macro
macro.hint: Runs for the clicking player, with their rights. Arguments: speaker, actor, token, character, scope (behavior, region, looter).

SceneZone.Hint: Clicking the region shows another scene to whoever clicks.

targetScene.label: Scene
targetScene.hint: The scene shown to whoever clicks.

activateForAll.label: Activate for everyone (GM)
activateForAll.hint: When the GM clicks, the scene is activated for the whole table instead of only viewed.

DocumentZone.Hint: Clicking the region opens a journal or a page.

document.label: Journal or page
document.hint: UUID of a journal or one of its pages.

grant.label: Grant read permission
grant.hint: If the player cannot read the document, the connected GM grants them Observer (permanent).

TileZone.HudTooltip: Create a DAS zone shaped like this tile
TileZone.Title: Tile → DAS zone
TileZone.Name: Name
TileZone.Hint: The region follows the image's visible outline (its rectangle if the image cannot be read). The other settings open next.
TileZone.NotOnCanvas: This tile is not on the viewed scene.
TileZone.Traced: Zone "{name}" ({type}) created from the image outline.
TileZone.Rectangle: Zone "{name}" ({type}) created on the tile rectangle: the image cannot be read.

enabled.label: Hidden
enabled.hint: Invisible and unusable for players until a character finds it (passive Perception when passing by, or "Search the surroundings"). Its tiles are hidden and its core behaviors disabled until then.

skill.label: Skill
skill.hint: The one that finds it: Perception (Search) or Investigation (Study).

dc.label: Detection DC
dc.hint: Passive score or search roll to reach.

passive.label: Passive distance
passive.hint: In scene units: a character who comes within this distance, in line of sight, finds it if their passive score reaches the DC. 0: no passive detection.

radius.label: Search radius
radius.hint: Maximum distance of an active search (the world setting, or less: a needle is only seen within 5 ft).

found.label: Found
found.hint: Uncheck to hide it again: tiles and behaviors go back to hidden, attempts are cleared.

text.label: Discovery text
text.hint: What the finding player reads. Empty: a generic text ("You notice a hidden cache.").

Wall.Hint: Secret door or ethereal wall: found by passive Perception or by "Search the surroundings", it becomes a regular door or stops blocking sight.

Budget.noAction: {name} has no action left this turn

TrapZone.Hint: A token entering the region triggers the trap: the trap actor uses its activity on the tokens in the effect area (resolved by the combat engine). Hidden by default; once spotted it shows in red, the engine's pathing avoids it, and it can be disarmed with a click (thieves' tools).

actor.label: Trap actor
actor.hint: The actor that 'casts' the trap (a 2024 DMG trap, or a hand-made NPC), with no token on the map.

activity.label: Activity
activity.hint: Id of the activity used. Empty: the one whose level range ("Levels 5–10") contains the targets' level (highest character, else highest CR), otherwise the first.

effectRegion.label: Effect area
effectRegion.hint: UUID of another region of the scene (the corridor swept by the jet of fire). Empty: this region. It stays hidden from players.

height.label: Height
height.hint: Above the area's floor (scene units), a token does not trigger: a flying creature passes. 0: only what touches the floor.

armed.label: Armed
armed.hint: Check again to re-arm the trap by hand.

delay.label: Re-arm delay
delay.hint: In minutes of world time (calendar), for 'after a delay'.

triggeredAt.label: Triggered at
triggeredAt.hint: World time of the last trigger (filled automatically).
